title: Independently audit safe GMGN wallet-stat mapping repair and bounded retest
objective: Independently audit GMGN-WALLET-STATS-SCHEMA-ADAPTER-REPAIR-001 without any provider or credential access. Verify from the committed parser, unit tests, bounded live runner, task spec, Harness manifest and sanitized acceptance report that: all output fields are allowlisted wallet/period aggregate values or stable safe codes; unknown provider keys/values cannot be emitted; every frozen wallet is Base58/32-byte validated before spawn; the runner has exactly two allowed period invocations and no retry, pagination, Helius, fallback or persistence path; mapped observations remain borrowed_unverified; reported period PnL is not labeled as cumulative/all-time or chain-verified profit; and the report contains no raw payload, credential-bearing URL, API key, arbitrary provider text, signature, counterparty, mint or trade record. Re-run the declared local acceptance commands only. Record GREEN_WITH_ADVISORY if the code/report evidence passes while GMGN supplied mapped aggregates for fewer than all eleven frozen wallets; do not call a provider to fill the gap.
forbidden_actions: Do not call GMGN, Helius, Dune, Chain.fm or any other provider or network endpoint; do not inspect, print or use credential values.
Do not modify application source, tests, the implementation task, its live report, package configuration, dependencies or run manifest.

Do not print, persist, commit or quote API keys, credential-bearing URLs, raw provider payloads, arbitrary provider text, full exception text, transaction signatures, counterparties, token mints or per-trade records.

Do not claim cumulative/all-time profit, realized chain-verified PnL, win rate, wallet quality, wallet classification, clustering, address-library eligibility, complete history or Alpha N/R/SR/SSR/UR tier.
Do not write outside the exact tracked write set.
